summaryZh: Levantine and Cyber-Archaeology Lab 研究南黎凡特从新石器时代到伊斯兰时期的社会演变，网站概述涉及约旦和以色列发掘及古代采矿、冶金与社会变化，并利用三维扫描、沉浸式可视化和高分辨率成像。
researchQuestions: 南黎凡特地区的社会如何演变，古代采矿与冶金在其中发挥什么作用？
topics: 黎凡特考古与社会演变
古代采矿、冶金及铁器时代
methods: 考古发掘与实验室分析
发掘沉浸式可视化及高分辨率成像

evidence.quote: Welcome to the UCSD Levantine Archaeology Laboratory.

The lab focuses on archaeological investigations concerning the evolution of societies in the southern Levant from the Neolithic to Islamic periods. Most of the data we analyze comes from our own excavations in Jordan and Israel.
This includes three dimensional artifact scanning, immersive virtualization of excavations, and ultra-high resolution imaging
